mechanism_narrative: Sustained week-on-week improvement in RETAIL_REC (rising from -43.3% to -36.1% over four weeks) indicates a consistent upward trajectory in consumer mobility. This momentum will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC higher than the baseline period mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 7.2 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the prior 28 days, or shows negative week-on-week change in more than two of the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Declining RESIDENTIAL mobility (from 13.9% to 11.4% over four weeks) signals residents spending less time at home and more time outside. This behavioral shift toward outdoor and retail activity will accelerate RETAIL_REC gains over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 2.5 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility stabilizes or increases while RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility has improved from -43.3% to -37.1% over four weeks, indicating commuting recovery. When TRANSIT rises above -35%, it triggers workplace return and associated retail foot traffic, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the subsequent four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT fails to exceed -35% within the next two weeks, or WORKPLACES does not rise concurrently, or RETAIL_REC declines despite TRANSIT improvement.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has recovered sharply from -50.3% to -20.6% over four weeks, indicating relaxation of outdoor activity restrictions. This policy regime shift enables broader mobility freedoms that extend to retail venues, driving RETAIL_REC gains over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 29.7 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: PARKS mobility reverses below -25% within the next week, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve despite sustained PARKS recovery above -20%.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has stabilized near -5.7%, indicating essential shopping patterns are normalized. When essential mobility stabilizes, discretionary retail mobility follows within one week as consumer confidence solidifies. RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains between -6% and -5% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stabilized at -5.7% in week t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM volatility exceeds 2 percentage points week-on-week, or RETAIL_REC does not improve within one week of GROCERY_PHARM stabilization.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has improved from -31.7% to -25.3% over four weeks. When workplace return exceeds -25%, commuter-driven retail activity (lunch, shopping near transit) accelerates within two weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC above baseline.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 6.4 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES fails to exceed -25% within the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not show measurable improvement within two weeks of WORKPLACES crossing -25%.

mechanism_narrative: The convergence of improving TRANSIT (-37.1%), WORKPLACES (-25.3%), and PARKS (-20.6%) signals a seasonal reopening regime. In this regime, all three mobility categories must improve concurrently to sustain RETAIL_REC gains. Failure of any single category will suppress retail recovery.
candidate_trigger: all three of TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, PARKS improve week-on-week simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:all three categories improved over four weeks
failure_condition: Any of TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, or PARKS reverses by more than 3 percentage points in a single week, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve despite concurrent improvement in all three proxies.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has shown consistent week-on-week gains (7.2 points over four weeks) while RESIDENTIAL has declined (2.5 points), indicating a behavioral regime shift away from home confinement. This shift will reverse if RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 12.5%, signaling renewed lockdown behavior that suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 12.5% in any week
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL remains below 12.5% for all four weeks ahead, or RETAIL_REC continues to improve despite RESIDENTIAL rising above 12.5%.
